prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished high-fidelity desktop application screen for RainyDays, a general AI desktop assistant for Chinese-speaking people who work with files, research, and Word/Excel documents. This is a functional application design, NOT a landing page, not a photo, no browser/device frame, no perspective. 1536x1024 landscape screen. Design direction explicitly chosen by user: quiet Claude Code / Claude desktop feel, conversational and text-first. Warm neutral porcelain background #F6F5F1, slightly darker sidebar #EEEDE8, near-black #2B2A27 text, subdued grey secondary text, restrained muted terracotta #B56649 accent. Clear crisp Chinese sans-serif UI typography, natural readable font sizes, generous but purposeful spacing, sophisticated alignment, understated 1px borders only where useful, modest rounded 10-14px input and message shapes. Assistant answers are unboxed flowing text; user request is a soft warm-grey compact bubble. Uniform delicate outline icons, no emoji, no purple, no glowing edges, no gradients, no decorative photography, no dashboard metrics. Real product title RainyDays with original simple four-stroke rain mark, not Claude logo. Show a working conversation with illustrative data, not an empty welcome screen. Exact main conversation title: “整理本周的研究资料”. User message: “帮我整理这份资料，生成一份简洁的研究报告和数据表。” attached file pill “研究资料.pdf”. Assistant body: “资料已整理，报告和数据表已生成。” followed by short readable lines about “核心结论”, “保留来源与关键数据”, “你可以打开检查，或继续提出修改要求。” Collapsed tool activity line: “已读取资料 · 已生成 2 份文件” with a small check icon. Artifacts named “研究报告.docx” and “研究数据.xlsx”, subtle file-type labels DOCX / XLSX, buttons “打开” and “继续修改”. Bottom composer placeholder “描述你想完成的事，或添加文件…” with attachment plus on left and terracotta square send-arrow button on right, small helper text “Enter 发送 · Shift + Enter 换行”. Calm model indicator “通用助手” and small “就绪”. All glyphs sharp and legible. Small unobtrusive footer “设计预览 · 演示数据”. No marketing slogans or fictional capabilities. Composition C — focus canvas with collapsed navigation. A 64px warm-grey navigation rail on far left: original rainmark at top, new-conversation plus and history outline icons below, settings gear bottom. No expanded text session sidebar. Slim main header: menu icon, conversation title at left; small “成果 2” disclosure and ellipsis at right. Extremely readable centered conversation 820px wide with natural whitespace. User message, tool summary and assistant response use same quiet style, but artifacts are gathered into a compact horizontal results shelf immediately ABOVE the fixed bottom composer, labeled “本次成果”, two file chips with DOCX/XLSX and filenames, subtle “展开” control. Not a dashboard; only one uninterrupted conversation plane with collapsed secondary tools. The composer and result shelf form a restrained bottom working area; all content visible without scrolling. Typography and spacing carry the design. Show meticulous well-balanced wide-desktop composition with relaxed margins, crisp line icons and tiny terracotta accent only at rainmark and send button.
